title: Normalization of the flat coefficient square under scalar tensor presentation
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$ and a field $k$ of characteristic $p>0$, with $p\ne\ell$, and separated finite-type $k$-schemes $X,Y$ [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be a $k$-morphism. Let $a:R\to S$ be a morphism of commutative condensed rings such that extension of scalars is exact on every scheme [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring, sk-def-sfb-coefficient-change]. Write $R_Z=p_Z^*R$, $S_Z=p_Z^*S$ for $Z=X,Y$, with the canonical compatible coefficient inverse-image isomorphisms [sk-def-sfb-coefficient-morphisms]. Work in the ordinary unbounded internal-module derived categories, identified with sheaf-module derived categories by [lem-pd-module-ringed-topos-derived-comparison]. Put $T_Z=S_Z\otimes^L_{R_Z}-$ and let $U_Z$ be exact scalar restriction; put $L_R=Lf_R^*$, $L_S=Lf_S^*$, $G_R=Rf_{R*}$, $G_S=Rf_{S*}$, with their specified scalar and geometric adjunctions [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull, sk-def-sfb-derived-extension-of-scalars]. Set $C=U_YS_Y$, $B=U_XS_X$, considered in degree zero, and let $\rho:L_RC\xrightarrow{\sim}B$ be the canonical restricted-regular pullback identification. Let $e_Z(M):U_ZT_ZM\xrightarrow{\sim}M\otimes^L_{R_Z}U_ZS_Z$ be the canonical balanced scalar-tensor identification, using symmetry to put the coefficient on the right [lem-sfb-internal-scalar-pullback-normalization].
Let $d:U_YG_S\xrightarrow{\sim}G_RU_X$ be the actual comparison [def-sfb-derived-comap-lower-star-iso], $b:U_XL_S\xrightarrow{\sim}L_RU_Y$ the canonical restriction/pullback comparison [lem-weil-pbc-ring-sheaf-change-adjunction], and $\theta:L_ST_Y\xrightarrow{\sim}T_XL_R$ the comparison conjugate to $d$ under the composite adjunctions (the inverse of [def-sfb-derived-pull-iso]). Then $C$ and $B$ are flat, $L_R,L_S$ are exact pullbacks, and $e_Z$ carries the scalar unit to $M\otimes^L(R_Z\to U_ZS_Z)$. The module-object scalar adjunction and this ring-sheaf scalar adjunction have the same units under the equivalence. Moreover $d$ equals the ring-sheaf derived direct-image comparison of [lem-weil-pbc-ring-sheaf-change-adjunction]; on K-injective $S_X$-complexes both are induced by the identical ordinary restriction/pushforward composite. Finally for every $M\in D(R_Y)$,
$$e_X(L_RM)\circ U_X(\theta_M)\circ b_{T_YM}^{-1}\circ L_R(e_Y(M)^{-1})
=(1\otimes\rho)\circ\mu_{M,C}:L_R(M\otimes^L C)\longrightarrow L_RM\otimes^L B,$$
where $\mu_{M,C}$ is the specified derived pullback tensor comparison [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-projection-mate-exact]. This is equality of the specified transformations in the derived category; the right side is induced on flat-term K-flat representatives by the inverse-image pure-tensor map $f^{-1}(m\otimes s)\mapsto f^{-1}m\otimes f^{-1}s$, followed by the coefficient identification.

proof.text: Multiplication preservation for the coefficient ring homomorphism proves flatScalarCoefficientMap_linear by expanding tensorHom_def'. Exact extension followed by exact restriction is isomorphic via the specified e.ordinary to tensorRight of the restricted coefficient; transport finite limits and finite colimits across this isomorphism. Geometric pullbacks are exact by module_pullback_additive_exact.

Apply lem-sfb-flat-scalar-unit-normalization at X and Y with the actual regular coefficient maps. It gives the two internal unit equations and the section scalar models with their tensor and adjunction-unit compatibility.

Apply lem-sfb-flat-scalar-geometric-coherence to these two normalized section scalar models. It gives equality of the actual direct-image map with scalarRestrictionPush, PullNormalized for the actual theta, the section pullback comparison and the section direct-image normalization and compatibility square.

Apply internal_scalar_mate_projection with the given tensor normalizations and the now proved PullNormalized theta. Its ScalarMatePullEquation gives the tensor square before canceling eY. Precompose with L_R(eY.inv), combine the two functor images, and cancel eY.inv followed by eY.hom. This yields precisely the final requested equation.

Step 3: the actual d is the derived ordinary comapLowerStarIso on K-injectives. It equals the ring-sheaf d because both satisfy the adjunct identity with the same b (take t = ε). Step 4: I checked the mate identity directly; U_X(q)j_X = b⁻¹L_R(j_Y). Step 5: λ⁻¹ agrees with this on generators via the coequalizer property, and localization (3) plus injectivity of the adjunction bijection give θ = λ. Step 6: the first equation of lem-sfb-internal-scalar-mate-projection with c = ρ and δ ↦ μ (lem-pd-module-ringed-topos-derived-comparison) gives the display. (4) Small cases a = id, f = id, S = 0 and unbounded M all check. (5) No new nodes and no cycle. No SGA. The 11 tool_uses are generic sheaf/derived-category tools; I accept them. Mathlib searches cover all three kinds. (6) Batch-5 finding: both flagged citations reach lem-pd-section-derived-pushpull-normalization only. The base statement already cited lem-pd-module-ringed-topos-derived-comparison, which has the same reach, so I do not return on this finding.
